To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a supervised learning approach for automatically generating ratings of affective attributes for German lemmas.

we developed a supervised learning algorithm for the calculation of four psycholinguistically relevant attributes (abstractness, arousal, valence and imageability) of 350,00 lemmatised German words, and that we found high correlation between our algorithm's ratings and human ratings.

(1) we developed an automatic algorithm that can predict the four affective dimensions abstractness, arousal and imageability, and valence with high accuracy; (2) we applied the algorithm to 350,000 lemmatised German words; (3) the algorithm was validated by comparing the automatically calculated ratings to human ratings, revealing high agreement across all rating types.
